title: Lessons
description: All the app's content: write, review, translate and publish lessons.
loadError: The lessons could not be loaded.

empty.title: No lessons yet
empty.description: Create a first lesson, or import the full syllabus from the Structure page.

list.caption: Lesson list
list.noMatchHelp: Change the search or the filters to widen the list.

delete.title: Delete this lesson?
delete.description: "{{name}}" will be deleted for good, with its quizzes and translations. This cannot be undone.

editor.newDescription: Fill in the details, then save. The lesson stays a draft until you publish it.
editor.title: Lesson title (required)
editor.titleRequired: Give the lesson a title before saving.
editor.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Compound interest, the wealth machine
editor.noModuleHint: Without a module, the lesson shows in no learning path of the app.
editor.summaryHint: One or two sentences: what the lesson covers and why it matters.
editor.emoji: Emoji shown in the mobile app
editor.emojiHint: Only learners see it, in the app.

published.label: Published
published.help: Visible to learners in the app.

editor.cannotPublish: To publish, first fix the items marked with a cross below.
editor.blockedTitle: This lesson cannot be published as it is
editor.blockedBody: Complete the items marked with a cross in "Before publishing", or switch it back to draft to save it.
editor.saveBlocked: Complete the lesson or switch it back to draft to save.
editor.previewHint: The lesson as it will appear in the app, with your current changes.
editor.unsavedBody: Your changes to this lesson will be lost.

checks.title: The lesson has a title
checks.content: At least one block has text
checks.quizQuestion: Each quiz has a question and at least two answers
checks.quizCorrect: The correct answer of each quiz is filled in
checks.quiz: The lesson has at least one quiz
checks.translations: The lesson is translated into English and Spanish

help.hook: A question or situation that makes people want to read on.
help.real: A real case, with figures if possible.

placeholders.hook: e.g. You earn €1,500 a month. Where does your money really go?
placeholders.content: Block text. Wrap a word in **two asterisks** to make it bold.
placeholders.tip: e.g. Automate your savings transfer on payday.
placeholders.trap: e.g. Do not count bonuses as regular income.

blocks.emptyTitle: This lesson has no content yet
blocks.emptyHelp: Add blocks one by one, or generate a first draft with AI from the title.
blocks.markupHint: Tip: **word** shows in bold in the app. Use the arrows to reorder blocks.

quiz.question: Question
quiz.questionPlaceholder: e.g. What share of income goes to savings?
quiz.explanationHint: Shown after answering: why it is the right one.
quiz.emptyHelp: A lesson can be published without a quiz, but a question helps learners remember the key point.

ai.generatingHelp: AI writes the blocks and a quiz from the title, level and module. It takes 10 to 30 seconds; you can review everything before saving.
ai.generated: First draft generated. Review it, then save.
ai.translatingHelp: AI translates the title, blocks and quizzes. It takes 10 to 30 seconds.
ai.translated: Translations added. Review them, then save.
ai.needTitle: Give the lesson a title first: AI uses it as the brief.
ai.replaceContentBody: The blocks and the first quiz question will be replaced by the generated ones. Nothing is saved until you click "Save lesson".
ai.replaceTranslationsBody: The current English and Spanish translations will be replaced, including your corrections.

translations.intro: French is the reference language. Translations show in the app based on the learner's language.
translations.partialHelp: Only the title is translated: the lesson counts as not translated until a block is. Run the translation to complete it.
translations.removeBody: It will be removed from the lesson when you save. You can generate it again with AI.
translations.outOfSync: French has {{fr}} blocks and this translation {{n}}: translate again to bring it up to date.
translations.title: Title

newModule.title: Create a module
newModule.description: The module is created right away. You can complete it in Domains and modules.
newModule.name: Module name
newModule.nameRequired: Enter a name with letters or numbers.
newModule.exists: A module already has this name.

preview.fallback: Blocks not translated yet: the app will show the French text.
preview.noBlocks: This lesson has no content yet.
